capabilities: insert inline callouts with icons, labels, and colors via a modal
modify existing inline callouts through a modal
autocomplete Lucide icon names while typing
customize colors and styles through CSS variables and the Style Settings plugin
disambiguation: Renders small inline badges within text, not the block-level callout boxes of Obsidian's core Callouts feature.
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.13.0 or later because the settings tab uses the declarative settings API; older vaults are offered v0.1.12. README lists caveats: consecutive callouts need a separator, callouts do not work inside links, labels do not render Markdown or HTML, and pipes must be escaped inside tables.
intentEvidence: a successor to the Badges plugin by the same author
problem: Obsidian callouts only render as block-level boxes, so there is no built-in way to show small icon badges inline within a sentence.
